tables.name: Reason for Construction
tables.description: Why the decision was made to build the fortress.

results.name: Mortal Command
results.description: It was the dying wish of someone important to the builder.

results.name: Immortal Command
results.description: A god, or powerful otherworldly being, commanded it be built.

results.name: Vanity
results.description: The fortress was commissioned as a demonstration of power, wealth, or self-importance.

results.name: Protection
results.description: It was built to keep a particular thing, or place, safe or hidden.

results.name: Panic
results.description: The construction was motivated by fear of what would happen if they didn’t.

results.name: Prophecy
results.description: It was foretold that a fortress would be needed on this site.

results.name: Decree
results.description: A ruler, or governing group, ordered that it be built.

results.name: Life’s Work
results.description: It was built as a labor of love by a dedicated craftsperson and their team.

results.name: Conversion
results.description: The building was formerly used for another purpose, but constant additions and changes made it what it is today.
